fact: The Daily News reports that the Tanzania Revenue Authority's Integrated Domestic Revenue Administration System (IDRAS) began operation in January 2025, with a first phase of vehicle registration and driver's licence systems launched in February 2025.

The Tanzania Revenue Authority's Integrated Domestic Revenue Administration System (IDRAS) was scheduled to launch on 9 February 2026, replacing separate VAT and other platforms with one system handling registration, return filing, payments, objections and sales monitoring, per the Commissioner for Domestic Revenue.
